_comment: Typed parameter schema per operation type (PRD-11). Authored single source; seeded into mfdb_operation_parameter_def. The table itself is .dic-declared/generated; consolidating this authoring into the .dic natively is a documented refinement.

microtime_shift.name: global_shift
microtime_shift.description: Global micro-time shift applied to all routing channels.

microtime_shift.name: shift
microtime_shift.description: Per-channel micro-time shift; one repeatable row per routing channel (role = channel).

burst_selection.name: min_photons
burst_selection.description: Minimum number of photons for a burst to be selected.

burst_selection.name: time_window
burst_selection.description: Sliding time window for burst search.

burst_selection.name: photon_window
burst_selection.description: Number of consecutive photons in the search window.

burst_selection.name: filter_active
burst_selection.description: Whether the photon filter is active.

burst_selection.name: count_rate_time_window
burst_selection.description: Time window for the count-rate filter.

burst_selection.name: delta_macro_time_min
burst_selection.description: Minimum delta macro time for the inter-photon-time filter.

burst_selection.name: delta_macro_time_max
burst_selection.description: Maximum delta macro time for the inter-photon-time filter.
